event.game: San Francisco 49ers at Los Angeles Rams
facts: Kaelon Black carried 14 times for 65 yards.
Christian McCaffrey carried 10 times for 68 yards.
Jordan James was a healthy inactive, establishing Black as San Francisco's clear RB2.
Black rotated into the opening drive and handled substantial early-down work; McCaffrey retained third-down, short-yardage, and goal-line priority.

confirmed_vs_speculative.confirmed: Official box-score usage and Jordan James's inactive status.
confirmed_vs_speculative.analysis: Black appears to have standalone early-down work plus premium contingency value behind McCaffrey.
confirmed_vs_speculative.speculation: The exact Week 2 touch share may change with game script and McCaffrey's health.

fantasy_significance: Black's Week 1 workload materially increases his rest-of-season value from pure handcuff to clear RB2 with possible standalone early-down usage.
mongo_relevance: Kaelon Black is already OWNED by James and is on the Mongo bench. Hold him and do not treat him as a drop candidate.
